source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary:
Once per turn, when one of your units with this ability is selected to shoot in your [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), it can use this ability instead of making any ranged attacks. If it does, your army can gain a new **SPORE MINES** unit with 1 model per model in the unit using it, placed at any point on the battlefield:

- wholly within 48" of the unit using it
- more than 8" horizontally from every enemy unit

reminder.unresolved: Withheld as a class: independent reviews found 4 of 86 sampled reminders of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, above the 2% this reading may ship with.

detail.trigger: selected to shoot in own Shooting phase
detail.replaces: making any attacks with its ranged weapons
